preconditions.description: The input integer n must be a positive integer within the range of 1 to 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if not is_hill_number(n) else stdout == str(count_hill_numbers(n))
postconditions.description: If n is not a hill number, output -1; otherwise, output the count of hill numbers less than or equal to n.
